description:
Put the Martech SDK into AI Design, on iOS and Android, and prove it works.

AI Design is the pilot: the first real integration, and the one that will surface the gaps in the SDK, the docs and the verification suite.

Each platform is split in two:
- Integrate - MTSDK-52 (iOS), MTSDK-53 (Android). Put the SDK in the app.
- Verify - MTSDK-56 (iOS), MTSDK-57 (Android). Prove analytics, attribution and billing still work.

The split is deliberate. The verification harnesses need an app that already has the SDK in it, and the integration cannot be called correct until those harnesses have run against it. So: integrate first, verify second.

iOS goes first. MartechKit already has the test seam and the mocks. Android waits on Platform Convergence (MTSDK-25), because integrating against an API that is actively being reshaped buys a rewrite.

Acceptance criteria:
- AI Design runs the Martech SDK on iOS and on Android
- No 3rd-party SDK (AppsFlyer, Amplitude, RevenueCat, Meta, TikTok, Firebase) is initialised directly by the app
- The verification suite is green on both platforms
- Time-to-integrate is recorded per platform - this is the baseline for every later app
- Any place the Android path differs from the iOS one is filed against MTSDK-25, not worked around in the app
